events.text:
Plate B:2077 is the **MICROSCOPE, Plate CCC** (Plate 300). It shows a compound microscope with its parts lettered and labeled across several figures (figure labels around Fig. 2.2–2.4 and 4.4–4.5 are visible: the microscope tube/body with objective and eye lenses, the stage, stage forceps, mirror, and the instrument mounted on its stand).

It is explained on the adjacent page **[R:2078]** (page_id `britannica:309f765b1ecc83e0a7f7762e44b4a927a7555443:train:2078`, same volume 149983206), whose running head reads "MICROSCOPE. / Plate CCC." — i.e., the plate belongs to and is keyed to the MICROSCOPE article of the Encyclopaedia Britannica. Note: the scan of row 2077 itself is a faint/blank plate leaf with no readable text; the plate image and its figure labels appear on the neighboring page R:2078.

Plate B:2077 is the **MICROSCOPE, Plate CCC** (Plate 300). It shows a compound microscope with its parts lettered and labeled across several figures (figure labels around Fig. 2.2–2.4 and 4.4–4.5 are visible: the microscope tube/body with objective and eye lenses, the stage, stage forceps, mirror, and the instrument mounted on its stand).

It is explained on the adjacent page **[R:2078]** (page_id `britannica:309f765b1ecc83e0a7f7762e44b4a927a7555443:train:2078`, same volume 149983206), whose running head reads "MICROSCOPE. / Plate CCC." — i.e., the plate belongs to and is keyed to the MICROSCOPE article of the Encyclopaedia Britannica. Note: the scan of row 2077 itself is a faint/blank plate leaf with no readable text; the plate image and its figure labels appear on the neighboring page R:2078.
